# Validate the vectorised aligner against the reference implementation, then redo nematode conservation
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
def get(u,**kw):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=120,**kw); r.raise_for_status(); return r
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rows=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aal=rows[0].split(); IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aal)}
Bm=np.full((21,21),-4.0)
for line in rows[1:]:
    p=line.split()
    for j,x in enumerate(p[1:]): Bm[IDX[p[0]],IDX[aal[j]]]=float(x)
enc=lambda s: np.array([IDX.get(c,20) for c in s])

def nw_fast(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    S=Bm[np.ix_(enc(s1),enc(s2))]
    Mprev=np.full(m+1,NEG);Xprev=np.full(m+1,NEG);Yprev=np.full(m+1,NEG);Mprev[0]=0.0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Yprev[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),np.int8); ptr[0,1:,2]=2
    ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        M=np.full(m+1,NEG);X=np.full(m+1,NEG);Y=np.full(m+1,NEG)
        X[0]=go+ge*(i-1); ptr[i,0,1]=1
        c=np.vstack([Mprev[:-1],Xprev[:-1],Yprev[:-1]]); k=np.argmax(c,0)
        M[1:]=c[k,ar]+S[i-1]; ptr[i,1:,0]=k
        c=np.vstack([Mprev[1:]+go,Xprev[1:]+ge,Yprev[1:]+go]); k=np.argmax(c,0)
        X[1:]=c[k,ar]; ptr[i,1:,1]=k
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            cc=(M[j-1]+go,X[j-1]+go,Y[j-1]+ge); kk=int(np.argmax(cc)); Y[j]=cc[kk]; ptr[i,j,2]=kk
        Mprev,Xprev,Yprev=M,X,Y
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((Mprev[m],Xprev[m],Yprev[m]))); A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=ptr[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append('-');ns=ptr[i,j,1];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append('-');Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=ptr[i,j,2];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0 and st!=2: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0 and st!=1: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb)),float(max(Mprev[m],Xprev[m],Yprev[m]))

accs={"WORM":"O02161","HUMAN":"O43615","YEAST":"Q01852"}
seqs={k:"".join(get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta").text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,v in accs.items()}
A,B,s=nw_fast(seqs["WORM"],seqs["HUMAN"])
al=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(A,B) if x!='-' and y!='-']
print("VALIDATION worm vs human: score=%.0f aligned=%d identity=%.1f%% (reference implementation gave 42.5%%, score 891)"%(s,len(al),100*np.mean([x==y for x,y in al])))

# ---- nematode set again ----
r=get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":"(xref:pfam-PF04280) AND (taxonomy_id:6231)","format":"fasta","size":"500"})
recs={};cur=None
for line in r.text.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith(">"): cur=line[1:]; recs[cur]=""
    elif cur: recs[cur]+=line.strip()
rr=[]
for hdr,s2 in recs.items():
    acc=hdr.split("|")[1] if "|" in hdr else hdr.split()[0]
    m=re.search(r"OS=(.+?)\s+OX=",hdr); org=m.group(1) if m else "?"
    rr.append((acc,org,s2,len(s2)))
nem=pd.DataFrame(rr,columns=["acc","organism","seq","len"])
nem=nem[(nem.len>=330)&(nem.len<=560)&(nem.acc!="O02161")]
nem["genus"]=nem.organism.str.split().str[0]
sel=nem.sort_values(["genus","len"],ascending=[True,False]).groupby("genus",as_index=False).first().head(26)
print("\nselected 1 per genus:",len(sel))

ref=seqs["WORM"]; cols={}; per=[]
for _,row in sel.iterrows():
    A,B,s3=nw_fast(ref,row.seq)
    pairs=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(A,B) if x!='-' and y!='-']
    idp=100*np.mean([x==y for x,y in pairs])
    # domain-split identity
    i=0; dn=[]; dc=[]
    for x,y in zip(A,B):
        if x!='-':
            i+=1
            if y!='-':
                (dc if i>=241 else dn).append(x==y)
            cols.setdefault(i,[]).append(y if y!='-' else '-')
    per.append([row.acc,row.organism,row.len,round(idp,1),round(100*np.mean(dn),1),round(100*np.mean(dc),1)])
perdf=pd.DataFrame(per,columns=["acc","organism","len","%id_full","%id_NTD_1-240","%id_CTD_241-425"])
print(perdf.sort_values("%id_CTD_241-425",ascending=False).to_string(index=False))
print("\nmedian identity to TIN-44 across %d nematode genera: full %.1f%%, NTD %.1f%%, CTD %.1f%%"%(
      len(perdf),perdf['%id_full'].median(),perdf['%id_NTD_1-240'].median(),perdf['%id_CTD_241-425'].median()))

cons=pd.DataFrame({"resi":sorted(cols),"tin44_aa":[ref[i-1] for i in sorted(cols)],
                   "n_aligned":[sum(1 for a in cols[i] if a!='-') for i in sorted(cols)],
                   "pct_id":[100*np.mean([a==ref[i-1] for a in cols[i]]) for i in sorted(cols)]})
for lab,lo,hi in [("presequence 1-40",1,40),("NTD 41-240",41,240),("CTD 241-425",241,425)]:
    sub=cons[(cons.resi>=lo)&(cons.resi<=hi)]
    print(f"  {lab}: mean per-site identity {sub.pct_id.mean():.1f}% ; mean coverage {sub.n_aligned.mean():.1f}/{len(sel)}")

cavity=[303,322,323,326,370,372,390,392,394,416,417,418,419]
print("\ncavity/lipid-contact equivalents, nematode conservation:")
print(cons[cons.resi.isin(cavity)].to_string(index=False))
print("\nmean per-site identity: cavity positions %.1f%% vs rest of CTD %.1f%%"%(
    cons[cons.resi.isin(cavity)].pct_id.mean(),
    cons[(cons.resi>=241)&(~cons.resi.isin(cavity))].pct_id.mean()))
print("\nalpha1-alpha2 loop region 274-290:")
print(cons[(cons.resi>=274)&(cons.resi<=290)].to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.8))
ax.scatter(cons.resi,cons.pct_id,s=5,color='#a0aec0',zorder=0)
ax.plot(cons.resi,cons.pct_id.rolling(9,center=True).mean(),color='#2b6cb0',lw=1.5)
for lo,hi,lab,col in [(1,40,'presequence','#f6ad55'),(41,240,'N-terminal domain','#9ae6b4'),(241,425,'C-terminal Tim44 domain','#90cdf4')]:
    ax.axvspan(lo,hi,alpha=.25,color=col); ax.text((lo+hi)/2,106,lab,ha='center',fontsize=8)
for r_ in cavity: ax.axvline(r_,color='#c53030',lw=0.8,alpha=.6)
ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.set_xlabel('TIN-44 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('%% identity across %d nematode genera'%len(sel))
ax.set_title('TIN-44 conservation across Nematoda (red: residues equivalent to human TIMM44 lipid-contact positions)')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
